description: Sets the four brand colours of the webinar pages: background, text, the button fill and the button text. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. `target` decides how far that reaches: site (default) changes the whole website through the Site Editor styles, and while emails follow the site colours, the emails too; email changes only the email templates. Say which of the two it is in ONE sentence before you write, because target site is the bigger change. Needs `session_id`. Colours are hex like #516028. After writing, the site reads the values back, and only then is the colour really changed. Read the current ones with wi_get_webinar_colors, which can also sample the host's own logo if they do not know their hex codes.

button_fill.description: The primary and call-to-action button colour, hex.

button_text.description: The text on those buttons, hex.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

target.description: site changes the whole website and the emails, email changes only the email templates. Default site.

name: wi_change_webinar_colors
title: Change the colours of the webinar pages
